description: Give the project’s share link, to send to a client or anyone outside the team: they open the project without an account and comment (or, with access "view", only look). A project has one link: the first call makes it, later ones give the same link. `access` changes what guests may do for everyone on the link. A link the team paused or that expired stays closed; `reopen` opens it again, only when the user asks for that. Anyone with the link gets in, so only share when the user asks.

access.description: comment: guests can comment. view: they can only look. Left out: as it is (a new link lets them comment)

project.description: The project, by name or id from list_projects. Only needed when the token reaches several projects

reopen.description: Open a paused or expired link again

name: share_project
title: Share a project
